abstract: During an annual check-up in a 46 year-old man, a round mass was discovered in the left hypochondrium upon abdominal ultrasonography. Computed tomographic scan located the mass at the upper border of the body of the pancreas, suggesting an expansive process. Left pancreatectomy was performed, leading to the discovery of a dermoid cyst. This cyst was apparently part of the pancreatic parenchyma. Only 11 cases of dermoid cysts of the pancreas have been reported between 1918 and 1977. Elective enucleation of the cyst is thought to be adequate surgical treatment.
abstract_ja: 46歳男性の健診時の腹部超音波検査で、左季肋部に円形の腫瘤が発見された。CT検査で腫瘤は膵体部上縁に局在し、膨張性病変が示唆された。左膵切除術を施行したところ、類皮嚢腫が発見された。この嚢腫は膵実質の一部と思われた。1918年から1977年の間に膵類皮嚢腫の報告は11例のみである。嚢腫の選択的摘出術が適切な外科的治療と考えられる。
